notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
A small update that practically does not affect the gameplay:
- Fixed a bug due to which some fish were not saved in the inventory when exiting the game.
- Fixed achievement for killing Crystal Golem.
---------------------------
Thank you for attention!

notes.title: The game was released today!
notes.content:
Today the game was released!

Throne of Fate is a hardcore dynamic RPG roguelike, where you have to clear the land from the creatures that filled them. A Variety of locations, a lot of weapons, items used and invincible bosses are waiting for you in Throne of Fate!

If you find any bugs or bugs, please report them in a special topic in the discussions.

Have a nice evening, everyone!

notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
Today we released a new update that fixes the balance of weapons, as well as added tips to the game.

Minor bugs that were encountered during the game were fixed, and hitboxes for monsters were also fixed.

notes.title: Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the demo version of the game is out!

Plunge into the world of magic and mysteries, fight evil creatures, find unique weapons, get resources and defeat incredible creatures over and over again!

the demo version of Throne of Fate can be found on the game page!

The game is scheduled for release on October 21!
